title: "R packages"
---

### At ISGlobal

- **collin** Visualizing the effects of collinearity in distributed lag models. [Package](Rpkg_collin.qmd)

- **miclust** Multiple imputation in cluster analysis. [Package](Rpkg_miclust.qmd)

- **optimalAllocation** Optimal allocation for longitudinal studies with time-varying exposure. [Package](Rpkg_optimalAllocation.qmd)

- **tlm** Effects under linear, logistic and Poisson regression models with transformed variables. [Package](Rpkg_tlm.qmd)

### Other collaborations and teaching activities

- **exploreGLM** Descriptive analysis and Generalized Linear Model exploration. [Package](Rpkg_exploreGLM.qmd)

- **IP** Index of Performance (IP) for the Rugby Attack Assessment Instrument (RAAI). [Package](Rpkg_IP.qmd)

### Just for fun

- **christmas** Generates a number of Christmas cards, most of them being animated. The name of each card includes the year in which it was created. [Package](Rpkg_christmas.qmd)
